messages:
olga: Heads-up — MHC procurement requested artifacts to finish their security review: a redacted ISO excerpt, SOC2 one-pager, and a signed pen-test attestation. They also want Redwood to run a 3h weekend external vuln scan against staging and asked if that's billable. cc @ryan @maria

ryan: We can share redacted ISO excerpt + SOC2 summary. Pen-test attestation = our standard doc; security signs. If legal sends redlines it'll add time.

maria: Ops: we can run a 3h window but need firewall allowlist 24h prior, completed ATO form, and SSO account for the engineer. If they run the scan themselves, we hand over staging creds and sample target list.

ops-bot: HOSTED_SCANNER_IPS: 18.64.20.100, 18.64.20.101. Bastion fingerprint available on request (sha256:abcd1234...). For Redwood-run scans allowlist these two IPs.

olga: Customer prefers Redwood-run scan Saturday 23:00-02:00 UTC. They want a presigned ISO download and the signed attestation within 48h. Also asked whether Redwood retains scan output.

src-bot: SECURITY: We do not persist raw scan outputs. Ops retains a redacted incident log for reporting and RCA purposes under NDA. Pen-test attestation template: /compliance/templates/pen_test_signable_v1.docx. Manager approval required for signature; turnaround 1 business day if no redlines.

ryan: Pricing: artifact exchange is included. Hands-on scan facilitation & reporting is billable. Suggest a $850 one-time line named "POC scan facilitation & reporting (up to 3h)". quote-bot, please add.

quote-bot: QUOTE_UPDATE: Added line item "POC scan facilitation & reporting (up to 3h) — $850" to opportunity and attached pen-test template. Note: include "Customer responsible for firewall changes" in scope notes.

maria: I'll prepare the redacted ISO and generate a presign (48h). Presign command I'll use: `aws s3 presign s3://proofpacks/mhc/iso_redacted_v2.zip --expires-in 172800`

olga: Please post the presign link in thread when ready. I'll send to procurement and ask them to confirm the allowlist for 18.64.20.100/101 at least 24h before window.

maria: Uploaded and presigned (placeholder): https://redwood-evidence.s3.amazonaws.com/mhc/iso_redacted_presign?token=LMN123. Also placed pen-test attestation in CRM with request for security sign-off.

ops-bot: Confirmed scanner IPs in thread: 18.64.20.100, 18.64.20.101. Bastion IP option: 18.64.20.102. Need allowlist confirmation before starting.

src-bot: REMINDER: If legal redlines the attestation, tag #sec-legal and expect 2-3 business day delay. Manager-level approval needed for any wording changes.

olga: Thanks — action items: 1) maria post presign & attach attestation (done), 2) ryan confirm quote (done), 3) procurement to confirm firewall allowlist + ATO/NDA, 4) security to sign attestation once procurement confirms no redlines. I'll follow up with procurement and close the loop. :white_check_mark:
